cases.charge: You declared the house closed while Mara drank inside. That is not a mistake, it is a lie.

testimony.text: I saw the steam. The house was open. She was wrong, not lying.
Kenji saw the steam. Lucia's words were wrong, but not a lie meant to trap.
I heard the steam. A lie is a lie, even if you apologize twice.
Lucia didn't lie, she panicked. I saw her face! She's not a trap-maker, just scared.
I was inside! The steam was real. Lucia was wrong, but not a liar.
